input.quote: Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor
input.rationale: This is our walk-away scenario twice over: a blanket bar on Licensee assignment with no affiliate/M&A carve-out and no reasonableness standard (Article XXIV(c)), plus automatic termination on our change of control with a consent veto deemed reasonable whenever the acquirer competes with Licensor. Article XXII also gives Licensor a right of first refusal over a sale of our business, which we should delete separately. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out and removes the change-of-control termination trigger.

input.quote: ARTICLE III OWNERSHIP Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein.
input.rationale: Licensor's ownership of its own Platform is acceptable, but the Agreement is entirely silent on our data: "Intellectual Property Rights" is defined only as Licensor's rights, and there is no statement that we retain our trading, client and configuration data or any licence back for customisation work we fund under Article VII (which, combined with Article XXI, leaves our data with Licensor). Redline adds a Licensee Data ownership sentence, a no-joint-ownership statement and a perpetual licence to paid-for customisations.

input.quote: grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement
input.rationale: The grant runs to Licensee alone and Article II(e) limits access to "employees of the Licensee", excluding our Affiliates and the contractors who operate our desk with no path to add them; the licence is also conditioned on payment and terminable by Licensor on any breach, i.e. close to revocable at will, and is non-transferable. Redline extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors, makes it irrevocable during the term absent uncured material breach, and adds successor transferability.
